title: stajichlab/nf_funannotate1 pipeline parameters
description: Eukaryotic (fungal-default) genome annotation: clean, mask, RNA-seq train, funannotate predict/annotate/update, antismash/interpro/signalp

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Sample sheet, run scoping, and output locations.

samples.description: Path to the sample sheet CSV (SPECIES, STRAIN, ASMID, LOCUSTAG, BUSCO_LINEAGE, TRANSL_TABLE, NCBI_TAXONID, GENOME).

n_test.description: Process only the first N samples (0 = all). Useful for smoke tests.

taxon.description: Restrict to a taxonomic group as RANK:VALUE, e.g. PHYLUM:Ascomycota. Ranks come from sample-sheet columns.

asmid.description: Restrict to a single assembly by ASMID, e.g. GCA_000001405.15.

suppress.description: Optional newline/CSV list of ASMIDs to skip. Missing file is treated as empty.

target.description: Output directory for final genome annotations.

training_target.description: Output directory for funannotate training artifacts.

rnaseq_data.description: Output directory for assembled/normalized RNA-seq evidence.

seqcenter.description: Sequencing center label embedded in funannotate output.

reference_databases.title: Reference databases & evidence
reference_databases.description: External databases, protein evidence, and config seeds. Built-once dirs are storeDir-cached.

source.description: NCBI_ASM source dir; genomes resolved as <source>/<ASMID>/<ASMID>_genomic.fna.gz for rows without a GENOME column. Portable default is launchDir-relative; UCR HPCC overrides to the shared 1KFG staging dir (conf/site_ucr_hpcc.config).

taxondb.description: Local taxonkit/NCBI taxonomy database directory. Auto-downloaded by SETUP_TAXONDB (storeDir-cached) on first use, so the portable default just caches it under launchDir/work; UCR HPCC overrides to a shared download (conf/site_ucr_hpcc.config).

proteins.description: Protein evidence FASTA passed to funannotate (default: swissprot fungi).

funannotate_db.description: Local funannotate database dir; built once by SETUP_FUNANNOTATE_DB. Point at a prebuilt shared DB to skip the build.

eggnog_db.description: eggNOG-mapper database directory used by funannotate annotate (EGGNOG_DATA_DIR). Bound into the funannotate container as /opt/databases/eggnog_db; the image sets EGGNOG_DATA_DIR to that path. Must contain eggnog.db, eggnog_proteins.dmnd and the eggnog.taxa.db files. Not auto-downloaded by this pipeline -- populate it yourself (or override --eggnog_db) before --run_annotate. Portable default is a launchDir-relative placeholder; UCR HPCC overrides to the shared install (conf/site_ucr_hpcc.config).

augustus_config.description: Writable AUGUSTUS_CONFIG copy seeded once by SETUP_AUGUSTUS_CONFIG.

augustus_config_source.description: Source augustus config to copy from. null = autodetect from the provisioning env / augustus binary.

sbt_template.description: NCBI submission template (.sbt) used by funannotate.

genome_cleaning_masking.title: Genome cleaning & masking
genome_cleaning_masking.description: Assembly length-filter, FCS-GX contaminant purge, repeat masking, and TE library construction.

fcs_shm_script.description: Helper that stages the FCS-GX db into /dev/shm.

skip_fcs.description: Bypass the AAFTF FCS-GX contaminant purge (no ~470 GB gxdb / highmem); length-filter only.

clean_batch_size.description: Batch this many genomes into one GENOME_CLEAN_BATCH job (stages FCS-GX db once). 0 (or skip_fcs) = one job per genome.

genome_dir.description: Directory containing cleaned genome FASTAs (written by GENOME_CLEAN, read by ASM_STATS and earlgrey_mask.nf).

run_earlgrey.description: Use EarlGrey TE-discovery masking instead of tantan. Builds a curated TE library per species, then applies it with RepeatMasker to every conspecific assembly.

earlgrey_outdir.description: Directory for EarlGrey TE libraries and masked outputs (storeDir-cached per species).

earlgrey_workdir.description: Scratch directory for EarlGrey intermediate files.

earlgrey_version.description: EarlGrey module version to load (UCR HPCC Lmod; ignored under other provisioning profiles).

repeatmasker_version.description: RepeatMasker module version to load for per-strain masking (UCR HPCC Lmod).

repeat_taxon.description: Taxonomic group passed to EarlGrey -r (e.g. fungi, insects, vertebrates).

masked_dir.description: Destination for DELIVER_MASK output (finished masked FASTAs read by funannotate predict).

gen_asm_stats.description: Generate asm_stats.tsv.gz from cleaned genomes (used by earlgrey_mask.nf SELECT_REPS to pick the most contiguous representative per species).

tables_dir.description: Directory where asm_stats.tsv.gz is written and read.

rnaseq_sra.title: RNA-seq / SRA
rnaseq_sra.description: SRA discovery, fetch, trimming, and limits for RNA-seq training evidence.

fastq_hdr_script.description: Rust helper (or Python fallback) to fix FASTQ headers for Trinity.

readlen_script.description: Rust helper (or Python fallback) to enforce paired-read length matching.

run_sra_fetch.description: Fetch RNA-seq from SRA for training.

skip_sra_query.description: Skip the SRA discovery query step.

sra_query_batch_size.description: Species per batched SRA query job.

max_rnaseq_runs.description: Max paired-end SRA runs to use per species.

max_rnaseq_spot.description: Max spots to download per run (0 = unlimited).

max_rnaseq_reads.description: Max reads to retain per species after normalization.

enable_single_end.description: Also use single-end SRA runs when paired-end is insufficient.

max_rnaseq_se_runs.description: Max single-end SRA runs per species (when enable_single_end).

stop_after_trinity.description: Run representative funannotate train with --stop_after_trinity (funannotate >=1.9), archiving the shared Trinity-GG transcriptome without PASA. funannotate 1.8.x lacks this flag; set false to run a full persisted train instead.

prediction_training.title: Prediction & training
prediction_training.description: funannotate predict/train tuning and the small-and-fragmented pre-flight guard.

ani_reuse_threshold.description: ANI similarity (%) threshold for assigning strains as reuse-eligible representatives for ab-initio parameter sharing.

force_independent.description: When true, ignore any shared/reused GeneMark model and do a fresh ES/ET self-training for every assembly (never gmes_petap.pl --predict_with fast-reuse).

gene_prediction_shared_abinitio.description: Shared per-species ab-initio parameter store (parameters.json + <species_tag>.genemark.mod) populated by BACKFILL_ABINITIO_PARAMS and consumed by GENEMARK_RUN (--predict_with fast-reuse) plus ANI-based reuse. Empty = disabled, every assembly trains independently.

genemark_mode.description: GeneMark-ES/ET self-training mode. 'auto' = ES, or ET when a training BAM is available for that assembly; 'ES' = always fresh ES self-training; 'ET' = always ET (requires training BAM, else falls back to ES).

run_genemark.description: Run the standalone GeneMark-ES/ET step (GENEMARK_RUN) to train/reuse ab-initio models ahead of funannotate predict. false = skip it and let predict use --auto-skip-genemark (no ab-initio models).

genemark_path.description: Path to a user-local licensed GeneMark-ES/ET install directory containing gmes_petap.pl (licensed, so never containerized/conda). null = resolve via $GENEMARK_PATH (module load genemarkESET) then PATH. Mandatory under pixi/singularity provisioning.

header_length.description: GenBank/funannotate locus-tag header length cap (was a hardcoded per-sample constant).

max_cpus.description: Upper bound on CPUs handed to multithreaded tools.

predict_frag_max_contigs.description: Contig count above this counts as 'fragmented' for the predict guard.

predict_frag_max_n50.description: N50 below this counts as 'fragmented' for the predict guard.

predict_min_asm_bp.description: Assembled bp below this counts as 'small' for the predict guard (0 = disable guard).

pasa_mysql.title: PASA / MariaDB
pasa_mysql.description: MariaDB singularity service used by funannotate train/update via PASA.
Run the MariaDB service for PASA-backed train/update.

signalp_gpu.description: Run SignalP on a GPU queue with --nv passthrough plus a converted model checkpoint (vs CPU-only).

run_deeptmhmm.description: Run DeepTMHMM transmembrane-region prediction (feeds funannotate annotate --tmhmm).

deeptmhmm_gpu.description: Run DeepTMHMM on a GPU queue with --nv passthrough (vs CPU-only).

ani_reuse.title: ANI-based ab-initio reuse
ani_reuse.description: In-run ANI front-end (BUSCO genome completeness + skani all-vs-all + representative-strain picking) and representative gating of gene prediction.

run_ani_reuse.description: Compute BUSCO + skani ANI in-run and gate prediction on per-species representatives (eligible siblings fast-reuse the shared GeneMark .mod when available).

ani_outdir.description: Output directory for ANI tables and representative-strain reuse assignments.

ani_method.description: ANI comparison method (skani | mash | sourmash | fastani).

compare.description: ANI comparison grouping rank (in-run groups per species).

skani_min_af.description: skani --min-af minimum aligned fraction (%) to report a pair.

skani_compression.description: skani -c sketch compression override; 0 = preset default.

busco_lineages.description: BUSCO lineages tree (--download_path / BUSCO_LINEAGES) for BUSCO_GENOME. Must be v10-format datasets (funannotate predict's vendored BUSCO step needs the legacy lengths_cutoff files). Not auto-downloaded by this pipeline -- populate it yourself (`busco --download`) or override --busco_lineages. Portable default is a launchDir-relative placeholder; UCR HPCC overrides to the shared v10 tree (conf/site_ucr_hpcc.config).

genome_stats_outdir.description: Output directory for genome statistics (BUSCO_GENOME storeDir).

predict_scope.description: Prediction scope. 'all' (currently the only honored value) predicts every strain with representative gating.

allow_independent_fallback.description: When a species' shared ab-initio store is unavailable, its eligible siblings are excluded from prediction and reported to predict_blocked_awaiting_representative.tsv; true instead lets them train independently.

provisioning.title: Provisioning (containers / pixi)
provisioning.description: Software-provisioning settings; active only under the matching provisioning profile.

pixi_manifest.description: pixi.toml used by the pixi provisioning profile.
